result.title: Soybean Paste Stew (Doenjang Jjigae)

evidences.text:
add enoki mushroom
마지막으로 팽이버섯을 넣고

steps.text: Add 650ml of water to a pot and bring to a boil.
When the water boils, add 2 tablespoons soybean paste, 2/3 tablespoon chili pepper paste, and 1 tablespoon minced garlic.
Cut 1/2 onion into bite-sized pieces, add it to the pot, and stir to dissolve the pastes.
After boiling for about 5 minutes, add 1/2 tablespoon chili pepper powder.
Cube 1/2 block of tofu and slice 1 green onion, then add them to the pot and boil for about 3 minutes.
Finally, add enoki mushroom, boil for another 3 minutes, then turn off the heat.
